claims.statement: The root Makefile orchestrates the monorepo: server-serve/server-serve-2 run the Go server on 8080/8081 (with APP_CLIENT_SECRET=client_secret and APP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=null), e2e-test kills ports, spawns two servers, runs the test suite, and exits with the Playwright status, and test-all runs server-test + e2e-test + client-test in parallel (-j3).

The Zero Factory precommit gate runs three deterministic phases: format (gofmt -s -w on server, npm run fix on client), build (go build ./... && go vet ./... then npm run tsc), and test (go test -count=1 ./... on server); the Playwright E2E suite is skipped because it is infra-dependent.

The E2E test/ suite is driven via `cd test && npm test`, whose pretest step runs the tsc typecheck then a single parameterized build:harness esbuild script (test/scripts/build-harness.mjs) that produces both test/dist/harness.js and test/dist/unit-harness.js; invoking npx playwright test directly makes the specs fail with ENOENT on their missing harness bundles.

The Playwright config runs serially (fullyParallel: false) with a 10s timeout on Google Chrome only; workers: 1 is always pinned (locally and on CI) because the specs share two live server processes and zz-migrate.spec.ts latches one of them, and retries is 2 under CI=1 and 0 locally.

The precommit script is self-sufficient: if client/node_modules is absent it installs on demand via npm ci (fallback npm install), and it uses plain go test rather than go test -race because the race detector is unusable on the ARM host.

Protobuf changes are made only in proto/zerohub/v1/*.proto and regenerated with make proto-gen, which wipes the generated client/src/proto and server/pkg/proto dirs and invokes protoc with protoc-gen-ts_proto and protoc-gen-go in a single pass.

The client test suite includes regression unit specs run through the Playwright unit harness (which installs a mocked RTCPeerConnection and a globalThis MockWebSocket whose instances are tagged and record close() codes, and which records setRemoteDescription calls): unit-malformed-metadata.spec.ts pins that malformed hub or peer metadata is tolerated via the safeParseJson fallback; unit-reconnect-peer-prune.spec.ts pins that hubInfoMessage roster reconciliation prunes peers no longer in the server roster after a reconnect; unit-ice-candidate-send.spec.ts pins the shared ICE-candidate wait-and-send behavior; unit-manual-offer-handling.spec.ts / unit-manual-answer-handling.spec.ts pin the onOffer/onAnswer manual-SDP paths; unit-migration-redirect.spec.ts pins the 1001 close-reason host validation, the self-redirect stop, and the host/hostIndex update on a valid redirect; unit-static-hub-endpoints.spec.ts pins that joinStaticHub dials /v1/static-hubs/join with the hub id and peerMetadata query params (static-hub create is deliberately not exposed on the SDK and is an admin-gated plain-HTTP endpoint); and unit-ws-replacement.spec.ts pins that connectToZeroHub tears down a previously leaked socket instead of leaking it.
